raw_text: The Doklam imagery recycling is a masterclass in low-cost cognitive warfare. China doesn't need to move a single soldier to generate strategic anxiety in India. Just re-release old footage through state media, let nationalist bloggers amplify it, and watch Indian media do the rest. The EXIF data is damning — these are 2017 photos. India's information defense architecture is simply not equipped to counter this kind of operation at speed.
